# Briefly Brilliant

> Plateau-to-breakthrough LSAT study guide. Score-matched resources powered by students who broke through the same wall.

Briefly Brilliant matches LSAT students with study resources that have actually moved scores for students at the same plateau. After a short quiz about current score, target, weakest section, timeline, budget, and learning style, students get a personalized list of resources and can join study groups.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and how matching works.
- [Quiz](/quiz): 8-question intake that builds a personalized resource plan.
- [Feed](/feed): Score-matched LSAT resources, filterable by section, type, source, and score band.
- [Stories](/stories): First-hand student score-journey stories.
- [Groups](/groups): Community LSAT study groups by score range and section focus.
- [Sign in](/auth): Account creation and login.
